title: Vesper and the Confession
author: Hazel Amberdale
blurb: Bram Quintana, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
